title: metrics-rollups
blurb: Minute rollups split at the wrong boundary, late points vanish, and new metric names grow without limit.
brief:
This in-memory metrics store rolls timestamped samples into fixed UTC buckets. Production dashboards disagree across instances, delayed samples never appear, and a tenant can create unbounded metric names.

Read `README.md` for the exact retention, future-sample, and cardinality contract, then run the tests. Time is injected: do not read the wall clock directly.

**Your job:** align buckets to the Unix epoch, accept late-arriving points that are still retained, reject future-dated points, calculate independent min/max/average/count rollups per metric, and enforce the active-metric limit. Make all tests green without changing the public API.
